question: Who among the following has been appointed as the CEO of the Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC) in October 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Manoj Kumar Dubey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manoj Kumar Dubey** was appointed as the **CEO of the Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC)** in October 2024.
 
• The **Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC)** is the dedicated financing arm of the **Indian Railways**, responsible for raising financial resources for railway projects.
 
• Manoj Kumar Dubey has a strong background in **finance and management**, making him a suitable choice for this critical role.
 
• IRFC plays a crucial role in supporting the **infrastructure development and modernization** of Indian Railways.
 
• Under his leadership, it is expected that IRFC will continue to focus on **innovative financing mechanisms** and efficient resource mobilization.
 
• His appointment aligns with the government’s vision to further enhance the **efficiency and growth** of Indian Railways through robust financial planning and execution.
 
• The appointment was made following due processes, ensuring that the candidate’s qualifications and expertise aligned with the demands of the role.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ajit Kumar Saxena**__

 __
 
• **Ajit Kumar Saxena** is known for his expertise in the field of **administration and operations**, particularly in the public sector.
 
• He has served in various important roles but was not appointed as the **CEO of IRFC**.
 
 
 
• **Vijaya Kishore Rahatkar**__
 __
 
• **Vijaya Kishore Rahatkar** is a prominent leader known for her contributions in the field of **social and political development**.
 
• She has been associated with various **governmental and non-governmental organizations**, but her role is unrelated to IRFC.
 
 
 
• **Paramesh Sivamani**__
 
 
• **Paramesh Sivamani** is recognized for his work in the **technical and engineering domains**.
 
• While his expertise is significant, he was not selected for the role of **CEO of IRFC**.
